name: Blood Curse of Binding
description:
As a Bonus Action, you attempt to bind a Large or smaller creature you can see within 30 feet of you, which must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, the cursed creature’s speed is reduced to 0 and it can’t use Reactions until the end of your next turn.
	**Amplify**: On a failed save, this curse lasts for 1 minute and can affect any creature regardless of size. The cursed creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the curse on itself on a success. On a successful save, the target’s speed is instead halved until the end of your next turn.
